questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means the action is not allowed. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that ahead is a divided highway. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. You must obey it. Do not pass other vehicles where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. A traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. Drive to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and let other traffic go first before you enter the intersection or roadway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: Your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads divided by a median or guide rail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign (usually yellow with black markings). It tells you a sharp turn is coming. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the fastest legal speed for that area in good conditions. You may need to drive slower when conditions are bad.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm out straight with palm down and swings their arm down to their side, following riders should decrease speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow diamond-shaped warning signs alert drivers to upcoming hazards and road conditions. This sign warns you that a curve is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow diamond-shaped warning signs alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that a steep hill is ahead. Slow down and adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals instead of mechanical turn signals. When the left arm is bent at the elbow and points upward, it means the rider plans to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Yellow diamond-shaped warning signs alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that the right lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The group will pull off at the next exit.

questions.explanation: Hand signals are used for communication in group riding. When the lead rider raises their left arm with the index finger extended, it signals the group to ride in a single line.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means left turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow and black warning signs alert drivers to upcoming hazards and road conditions. This sign warns you that a lane is ending. Be ready to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: This orange sign warns drivers about construction ahead. Slow down and drive carefully in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane is ending. Move to the left lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers to be cautious because the road may be wet and slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign means you must stop. Yield to other traffic and pedestrians, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the roadway in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: You must come to a complete stop at this sign. Yield to all traffic and pedestrians. Proceed when the intersection is clear.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you may turn left on a green light, but you must yield to oncoming traffic. Complete your turn only when it is safe.
